classification.difficultyReason: Translate doorways into graph connections, match rooms using degrees and adjacency, include the outside as a vertex, and recognise interchangeable room labels.

content.prompt: The network diagram on the left shows how rooms A, B, and C are connected.

spec.description: Three labelled rooms, one A–C doorway and two B–C doorways.
spec.mathematics: Room adjacency is AC once and BC twice; no AB doorway.

spec.description: A and B above C; one AC edge and two distinct curved BC edges.

inlines.text: A separate house is shown below. Use the network diagram on the right to identify the rooms A, B, C and D.

spec.description: Four unlabelled rooms. Three doorways in the vertical divider and one in the lower-left horizontal divider; no exterior doors.
spec.mathematics: Upper-left room has three neighbours; upper-right has one; lower-left and lower-right each have two and are adjacent.
spec.answerVisibility: Room labels withheld for student response.

spec.description: Four vertices and edges AB, AC, AD and BC. AD crosses BC without a vertex.

answer.short: Upper left: A. Upper right: D. Lower left: B and lower right: C, or vice versa.
answer.worked: The upper-left room has three doorways, so it is A. The upper-right room has one doorway, so it is D. The two lower rooms each connect to A and to each other, so they are B and C in either order.

spec.description: Complete labelled floor plan showing one valid assignment; B and C may be interchanged.
spec.mathematics: The displayed assignment realises AB, AC, AD and BC.

children.label: b
children.prompt:
The network diagram below represents connections between four rooms and the outside (O).

Use the information to identify which rooms are A, B, C and D.

spec.description: Edges AB, BC, curved AC, AO, BO, CO and DC. B splits the horizontal route; diagonal crossings have no dots.
spec.mathematics: C has degree 4, D degree 1, A and B degree 3, and O degree 3.

spec.description: Full-width top room, large lower-left room and two stacked right rooms. All internal and external doorway gaps retained.
spec.mathematics: Internal connections: top–left, top–upper-right, left–upper-right and left–lower-right. Exterior doors: top, upper-right and left.

answer.short: Large left room: C. Lower-right room: D. Top room: A and upper-right room: B, or vice versa.
answer.worked: The large left room connects to three rooms and the outside, so its degree is 4 and it is C. The lower-right room connects only to C, so it is D. The top and upper-right rooms each connect to C, the outside and each other, so they are A and B in either order.

spec.description: Complete labelled plan showing one valid assignment; A and B may be interchanged.
spec.mathematics: All seven graph edges correspond to doorways, including three exterior doors.
